lead.headline: Two byes in the lineup — and a 2.24-point win banked
lead.deck: Week 10 beat the unbeaten team. Week 11 starts with Golden and the Rams on bye in your lineup: swap in Pickens and Wilson.
lead.body: Bad news first: Golden and the Rams D/ST are on bye and both are still in your starting lineup; Josh Jacobs is out after finger surgery; Woody Marks did not practise Monday with a concussion and Ryans doubts he plays Thursday, while David Montgomery practised in full. Week 10 was a 136.26-134.02 win over 9-0 Maye-day with 34.8 left on the bench, almost all of it Pickens' 43.5 (archive) — a projection call, not an error. The fix this week is in the lineup: Pickens for Golden (a bye) and Wilson for Rice (a coin flip). The D/ST seat has no rule-clean answer; the fallback card spells out the cost.

doFirst.headline: Two lineup swaps
doFirst.deck: Pickens for Golden, Wilson for Rice — in the app's lineup screen, any time before Sunday 12:00.
doFirst.note: The D/ST seat is a fallback, not a move: no claim (priority never resets), and the only zero-cost drop is protected by an open thesis.
doFirst.empty: No waiver claim this week: nothing on the wire would start, and priority never resets. Set the two receiver swaps before Sunday 12:00.

roster.deck: The lineup as set starts two byes; the projection lineup is 17.2 points better with Pickens and Wilson.
